name: Verifiko shop connection for WooCommerce
author: verifiko

sections.description:
This plugin is free. It is for WooCommerce stores that are already approved on Verifiko. It does not create an account or register a shop.

After approval you receive an email with a connection key. Open WooCommerce → Verifiko, paste that key, and click Connect. The API key is for a manual integration and is not used here. You do not type the domain: the plugin reads the site hostname, and Verifiko compares it with the approved shop.

After a successful connection the screen stays on “Store connected to Verifiko” and lists the latest sends. The plugin sends the order number, status, customer email, and purchase time. It does not send the address or payment details. You do not create a webhook under WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → Webhooks.

By default, a review invitation can start when the order status becomes Completed. You can choose a different delivery status in the settings. Sending starts about 20 seconds after the status change so checkout is not delayed. If Verifiko does not respond, sending is retried up to five times.

The optional shortcode [verifiko_badge] shows the rating and a link to the Verifiko profile. The badge key is not required for orders to be sent.

The settings screen is in Serbian, for shop owners.

External services

This plugin is a client of the Verifiko service (https://www.verifiko.rs). It is free to install. To send orders, the shop must already be approved and the owner must paste the key from the approval email.

Only after Connect does the plugin call https://api.verifiko.rs. That first request sends the connection key once, so the shop can be recognized. Later orders send only the signature, the site hostname, the order number, the status, the customer email, and the purchase time. The address and payment details are not sent.

Privacy policy: https://www.verifiko.rs/privacy
Service: https://www.verifiko.rs

Activating the plugin does not send any data.
sections.installation:
1. Apply on Verifiko and wait for approval. The shop domain must be this site’s hostname, without www.
  2. Wait for the email with the connection key.
  3. In WordPress open Plugins → Add New, search for Verifiko shop connection for WooCommerce, and install it.
  4. Open WooCommerce → Verifiko.
  5. Paste the connection key and click Connect.
  6. Optionally choose which order status means delivered. The default is Completed.
  7. Place a test order and move it to that status.
sections.faq:
What if Connect fails?

The key is wrong when it does not match the email. If the message says the key belongs to another domain, this WooCommerce address is not the shop that was approved on Verifiko.

Do later status changes arrive?

Yes. Each later status change is sent. The status you choose means delivered. Cancelled, refunded, and failed remove the order from the invitation list.

Is the plugin free?

Yes. Installing it from WordPress.org is free. You still need an approved shop on Verifiko and the key from the email.
sections.changelog:
1.4.1

  • WordPress Playground and WP Sandbox (playground.wordpress.net, wpsandbox.wordpress.net) can connect with the issued key. Other addresses must still match the approved domain.
  • A refused connection names the site address, or the HTTP status returned by Verifiko.

1.4.0

  • The connected state stays on screen, with the last eight sends.
  • The merchant chooses which status means delivered.
  • The connection key is sent only when connecting.
  • A privacy policy suggestion is registered in WordPress.

1.3.0

  • Connection is one key from the email and a Connect button. The domain and API address are no longer typed.

1.2.1

  • Settings screen and rating shortcode follow the Verifiko site.

1.2.0

  • Sending is delayed so checkout is not blocked. Only a response with success true is accepted.
  • Activation no longer stops when WooCommerce is installed but not loaded yet.

1.1.0

  • Orders are sent directly by the plugin, with retries when Verifiko is unavailable.
  • The body contains only the id, status, email, and dates. Old WooCommerce webhooks created by the plugin are removed.

1.0.0

  • Settings, connection check, and badge shortcode.
